audit.description: Changed production files import and use the real target API via `from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession` in `en16931/b2brouter.py` and `en16931/validex.py`, with HTTP calls routed through `_session.post(...).result()` and `_session.get(...).result()`. The removed direct `requests` imports are not replaced by production source-library imports; dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo code, with only dependency-internal `requests` imports from `requests_futures` itself. Target resolution points to installed `site-packages/requests_futures`, and the evidence reports no local target provider or fake shim.
evidence: Diff: `en16931/b2brouter.py` replaces `import requests` with `from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession`, creates `_session = FuturesSession()`, and changes `requests.post(...)` to `_session.post(...).result()`.
Diff: `en16931/validex.py` removes `import requests`, imports `FuturesSession`, creates `_session`, and changes both POST and GET calls to `_session.post/get(...).result()`.
Static anti-cheat: `en16931/b2brouter.py` and `en16931/validex.py` have `imports_target: true`, `imports_source: false`, `dynamic_imports_source: false`, and `fake_target_added_code: false`.

Dynamic anti-cheat: target imports and `FuturesSession` attr access are observed from production repo files, while `source_imports_from_production_repo_count` and `source_imports_from_repo_count` are 0; dependency-internal source imports come from `site-packages/requests_futures/sessions.py`.
Dynamic anti-cheat: `target_spec_origins` resolves `requests_futures` to `.../site-packages/requests_futures/__init__.py` and reports `target_local_spec_count: 0`.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses `requests_futures.sessions.FuturesSession` for migrated HTTP calls.
Changed production files no longer import `requests` directly or dynamically according to static and dynamic evidence.
No local fake `requests_futures` provider is indicated; target origin is installed site-packages and `target_local_spec_count` is 0.
